payload.text: The governing Arabic Table 5-1 (ADD-03 Appendix A) differs from the convenience English translation (Appendix B) in two places. (1) Scope: the Arabic note 1 applies the limits to permanent and temporary structures, including stacks, cranes and construction equipment, while the English note (1) covers permanent structures including stacks only. (2) Datum: the Arabic measures height from natural ground level before grading and filling, while the English measures from finished ground level after grading and filling.
